items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: You ever hear of a guy by the name of Dollar Brand?

ctx.x: Who was the drummer when you joined?

We had several. Sam Woodyard was the first one that I worked with. Then Louie came in. Then there was Rufus Jones, and then there was the other Jones, Elvin Jones was there for a short time. Yeah I was amazed too. And there was another fella that he used, Chris Columbo — not Columbo, it’s Columbus. Chris Columbus or Columbo. A fellow out of Atlantic City. Chris, I call him Chris. But he was president of the local there for a while, and he worked with the band for a while. And there were several others that sat in…
